question: Should OpenClaw expose `referenceContext` and `reference-context` as stable public plugin SDK surface now, make the lane explicitly experimental, or keep only a narrower internal Codex projection until the cross-host contract is designed?
rationale: The patch is technically plausible, but it defines public plugin API and security-sensitive prompt-authority semantics that require maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this PR for now, keep the linked issue canonical, and invite a maintainer-sponsored implementation after the API direction is chosen.

options.title: Sponsor experimental lane
options.body: A maintainer can ask for updates that mark the SDK lane and capability experimental with explicit docs and upgrade expectations before merge.

options.title: Sponsor stable lane
options.body: A maintainer can accept the compatibility and security-boundary commitment and proceed with this public SDK shape after final review.

recommendation.title: Close until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this PR for now, keep the linked issue canonical, and invite a maintainer-sponsored implementation after the API direction is chosen.

likelyOwner.reason: The central unresolved choice is the context-engine public API contract, and the history points most strongly to this owner for that surface.
